/.title: Auxilium Specialty | Insurance for Frontier Technology Risk
/.description: Auxilium Specialty is a managing general agent insuring the risks of autonomy: AI liability for businesses that run AI agents, and robotics coverage for companies that deploy or make robots. Placed through brokers.

/digital-risk/ai-liability.title: AI Liability Insurance | Auxilium Specialty
/digital-risk/ai-liability.description: The Autonomous Operations Policy covers what your AI agents do: the money they move, the commitments they make and the records they change. Written in the E&S market through your broker.

/coverages.title: Coverages | Auxilium Specialty
/coverages.description: Insuring the industrial revolution: the risks of autonomy across the digital and physical worlds. AI liability for the businesses that run AI agents, two robotics lines, and the risk-mitigation software that comes with the policy.

/about.title: About Auxilium Specialty | Insuring Industrial Revolutions
/about.description: Autonomy is outpacing insurance. Auxilium, Latin for help or support, is a managing general agent that insures the risks new technology brings with it, so businesses can adopt it with confidence.

/partners.title: Partners: Brokers and Carriers | Auxilium Specialty
/partners.description: Place frontier-technology risk with Auxilium, or build capacity as a carrier or reinsurer. AI Liability and the robotics lines are placed through licensed brokers.

/insights.title: Insights | Auxilium Specialty
/insights.description: Analysis on AI liability, agent governance, and the emerging risks of frontier technology from the Auxilium Specialty underwriting team.

/privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Auxilium Specialty
/privacy.description: How Auxilium Specialty collects, uses, and protects information across its insurance and software offerings.

/terms.title: Terms of Service | Auxilium Specialty
/terms.description: The terms governing use of the Auxilium Specialty website, software, and services.

/software/auxcontrol.title: AuxControl: active risk mitigation for insureds | Auxilium Specialty
/software/auxcontrol.description: The risk-mitigation suite included with an Auxilium policy: adversarial testing of deployed agents, accreditation, and continuous governance.

/robotics/robotic-protection.title: Robotic Protection | Auxilium Specialty
/robotics/robotic-protection.description: Autonomy is physically deployed, we got you covered. Robot damage, collateral damage, operational interruption, robot liability and incident response for every company running robots, through your broker or included when you buy or lease the robot.

/robotics/robot-maker-coverage.title: Robot Maker Coverage | Auxilium Specialty
/robotics/robot-maker-coverage.description: For robot makers, vendors, integrators and service companies: products liability, recall and field fix, performance E&O and general liability, with autonomy covered, not excluded.

/login.title: Log In | Auxilium Specialty
/login.description: The Auxilium portal for brokers, underwriters, carriers, and policyholders is coming soon.
